subject: Observability add-ons pricing: retention, tracing, advanced dashboards
messages:
From: Liam Harper <liam@clearpath.io>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Observability add-ons: retention/tracing/dashboard pricing

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the product demo last week — the dashboard walkthrough was helpful. We're evaluating Redwood's observability add-ons for a production rollout (retention, distributed tracing, and the advanced dashboard pack) and need a commercial proposal to present to our procurement team next week. High-level items we care about:

- Retention tiers (30 / 90 / 365 days) and pricing per GB/month
- Tracing ingest and storage costs; effective per-span pricing guidance for high-cardinality traces
- Advanced dashboard licensing (per-seat vs capacity-based) and any bundling discounts with retention/tracing
- SLA language for trace availability and retention guarantees
- Any pilot credits or demo-period pricing for a 3-month POC

Attached is our procurement questionnaire for context. Our initial rough numbers: ~2 TB/month telemetry, ~1.2M traces/day, ~25 dashboard users.

Can you send a short commercial checklist and an estimated price range by EOD Thu (July 17)? Procurement expects the high-level SOW and pricing to kick off approvals.

Best,
Liam
Liam Harper
Head of Platform Engineering
ClearPath Analytics

Attachment: procurement_questionnaire.pdf

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Liam Harper <liam@clearpath.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons: retention/tracing/dashboard pricing

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear requirements and the questionnaire. Putting an initial commercial checklist below so procurement has a clean doc to review. Attaching the short pricing-sheet and a dashboard mockup for the advanced pack.

Quick checklist / notes:
- Retention: 30/90/365 tiers available. Ballpark pricing: $0.12/GB/mo (30d), $0.085/GB/mo (90d), $0.06/GB/mo (365d) — these are list prices; volume/commit discounts apply.
- Tracing: two components — ingest (per 1k spans) and indexed storage. For your volume (~1.2M traces/day) estimated ingest cost ~ $1,000–$1,400/mo at list; indexing add-on is additional.
- Dashboards: recommended capacity-based for your team. Tier for ~25 users maps to the Mid visual pack; baseline monthly list ~$2,000/mo.
- Bundling: common to offer 10–20% off for combined retention+tracing+dashboard commitments; exact % is use-case dependent.
- SLA: standard Add-on SLA includes 99.9% availability for dashboard delivery; retention durability and retention-guarantee language can be added to Private/Dedicated customers or with a committed package.
- Pilot: we can offer a 3-month POC with a $10k credit toward committed spend if you convert to a 12-month contract.

If you can confirm two things: desired retention tier (30/90/365) and whether you want indexing for traces, I can share a formal quote and an initial concession path for a 12-month commit.

Next steps:
1) Quick call with Ben (pricing) to validate numbers — can you do Thu 07/17 at 10:00 PT?
2) Confirm retention tier and indexing requirement
3) We'll provide a redline-ready SOW + draft SLA and a one-page concession summary.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing-sheet.pdf, dashboard-mockup.png

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Observability add-ons: retention/tracing/dashboard pricing — internal pricing check

Forwarding the ClearPath thread — they want an expedited commercial checklist and a concession path for a potential 12-month commit. Key numbers from their note: ~2 TB/mo telemetry, ~1.2M traces/day, 25 dashboard users.

My read / asks:
- Recommend we price their 365-day retention as a committed tier: list $0.06/GB -> propose 20% off for 12mo commit (effective $0.048/GB) plus a 3-month pilot credit of $10k.
- Tracing: offer indexing as an optional bolt-on. For ingest, suggest a 12-month committed slab with overage at list; propose 15% off list for committed volume.
- Dashboard: convert to capacity-based monthly and offer a $500/mo credit for first 3 months.
- SLA: procurement asked for retention guarantee language — attach redline_sla.docx and ask Legal if we can include a limited durability commitment for Enterprise deals.

Ben — can you run margin impact if we do 20%/15%/3mo credits and confirm the price-to-margin tradeoff? Kimberly — can you prep an SOW template and the SLA redline for procurement?

Quote meeting scheduled with ClearPath Thu 07/17 10:00 PT -> I'll join and we should be prepared to make a soft concession on the bundled discount.

--
Tessa

From: Liam Harper <liam@clearpath.io>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearpath.io
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons: retention/tracing/dashboard pricing

Tessa / Ben — thanks for the checklist and for the quick call earlier. Procurement reviewed the suggested concessions and came back with the following counter: 15% off the combined list for a 12-month commit (we asked for 20%); a $7,500 pilot credit (instead of $10k); and a request to add a limited retention durability clause into the SOW (we provided suggested language in the attached).

We are comfortable moving forward fast if we can land at: 15% bundle discount, $7.5k pilot credit applied at signing, and the retention durability paragraph incorporated (we're not asking for an indemnity, just a measurable guarantee + audit log access). Can you confirm internal approval and next steps? Procurement is ready to accept a redlined SOW if Legal can accommodate simple retention-language edits.

Thanks —
Liam
Head of Platform Engineering
ClearPath Analytics

Attachment: procurement_redline_sla.docx
